summary: Retest of home-gallery-preview section. JSX IS present in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx (lines 269-300), but the section does NOT render on the live site because its render condition `galleryPreview.length > 0` is never satisfied. Root cause: the /media fetch is gated by `settings.about_gallery_groups[0].category`, and GET /api/settings returns `about_gallery_groups: []`, so the useEffect that populates galleryPreview never runs. Regression checks pass: club-zone-card-* = 4, shop-preview-card-* = 3, site loads, no JS errors.

minor.issue: about_gallery_groups is empty ([]). The Home page gallery preview section depends on settings.about_gallery_groups[0].category to know which media category to load. Without at least one group (e.g. {title:'Eventi', category:'gallery-eventi'}), the preview section is silently hidden.

ui_bugs.issue: Section never renders in production because galleryPreview stays empty. The useEffect at lines 41-47 short-circuits when settings.about_gallery_groups is []. Consider either (a) seeding at least one about_gallery_groups entry with category='gallery-eventi' in the backend/settings seed, or (b) adding a client-side fallback: if no group is configured, fetch a default category like 'gallery-eventi'.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend depends on settings.about_gallery_groups[0].category but backend seed leaves it empty; /api/media?category=gallery-eventi correctly returns 9 items so backend media data is fine, only the wiring/seed is missing.

action_items: Seed settings.about_gallery_groups with at least one entry pointing to an existing media category (e.g. {title:'Gallery Eventi', category:'gallery-eventi'}) so the Home gallery preview populates, OR
Add a fallback in Home.jsx useEffect: if settings.about_gallery_groups is empty, fetch /media?category='gallery-eventi' by default.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx gallery preview section is coupled to admin-configurable settings.about_gallery_groups with no fallback — any environment where an admin hasn't configured groups will silently hide the section. Provide a safe default.
The retest was requested assuming the section was rendering — verify the seed script actually writes about_gallery_groups on settings init.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10: confirmed home-gallery-preview JSX exists in Home.jsx lines 269-300 but does not render at runtime because /api/settings returns about_gallery_groups=[]. Not a stale-bundle issue as iteration 9 hypothesized. Fix must be either seed data on settings or a client-side fallback category. After fix, retest tiles 0-3, home-gallery-cta href=/il-club, section order (club → gallery → shop) on desktop 1920 and mobile 390.
rca of the issue: Home.jsx uses two useEffects: the first loads /settings; the second (lines 41-47) only fires when settings.about_gallery_groups[0]?.category exists. Backend /api/settings currently returns about_gallery_groups=[] (empty). Therefore galleryPreview never gets set, its length stays 0, and the JSX conditional `galleryPreview.length > 0 && (<section data-testid=home-gallery-preview>…)` short-circuits, so the section is absent from the DOM. Verified via direct curl on /api/settings and via page.evaluate in browser. Backend media endpoint itself is healthy (/api/media?category=gallery-eventi returns 9 items).
